---level7 script---

local isPlayingDemo = false
local countFail = 0
local isSkip = true
local hasViewedStory = global.getBool("lvl7_b1")

if not hasViewedStory or not game.isRestart() then
	repeat
		if hasViewedStory then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		
		game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(false)
		script.delay(1)
		sound.play("43-1")
		if dialog.show("Level7-1", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("57-1")
		if dialog.showMinTime("Level7-2", faceManyi,0) ==1 then break end
		if dialog.show("Level7-3", facePutong) ==1 then break end
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(false)
		camera.gotoPosition(360,1010)
		if dialog.showMinTime("Level7-4", faceZhoumei,0) ==1 then break end
		camera.gotoRole()
		if dialog.show("Level7-5", faceRenzhen) ==1 then break end
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)

		--set story viewed flag
        global.setBool("lvl7_b1")		
		
		game.restartTiming()
		game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
		isPlayingDemo = false
		isSkip = false
		
	until true
end

if isSkip then
	camera.gotoRole()
	camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
	dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
	game.resumeLogic()
	game.showTutorialDiagram(0)
	game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
	role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
	game.restartTiming()
end

onRoleReachedMoon = function() 
    game.pauseLogic()
    if global.isLevelPassed(15) then
		if global.getBool("stg_b1") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
			sound.play("60-2")
			if dialog.show("Stage1F-1", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("54-1")
			if dialog.show("Stage1F-2", faceManyi) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("58-1")
			if dialog.show("Stage1F-3", faceShengqi) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage1F-4", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage1F-5", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage1F-6", faceRenzhen) ==1 then break end
			global.setBool("stg_b1")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    else
		sound.play("49-1")
    	dialog.show("Level7-6", faceWunai)
    end
    game.success()
end
